# Architecture Brief — Comparative ledger merge for Slice C

resource: scripts/harness/prompt-router.mjs, scripts/harness/plan-review.mjs, scripts/harness/council-review.mjs, scripts/harness/merge-comparative-ledger.mjs, scripts/harness/test/comparative-ledger-merge-test.mjs, package.json

## Context sufficiency

| Artifact | Role | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prompt-router.mjs` | feature-run manifest + comparative ledger seed artifact | Harness routing |
| `plan-review.mjs` | emits machine-readable comparative review block | Review loop |
| `council-review.mjs` | emits reviewer responses + synthesis envelope | Council review |
| `merge-comparative-ledger.mjs` | run-id merger into final consensus/divergence artifact | Harness utility |
| `comparative-ledger-merge-test.mjs` | deterministic disagreement proof | Harness tests |
| `package.json` | command surfaces for utility + test | Project scripts |

Scope: non-trivial run-artifact integration and deterministic validation.

## Understand packet

- Graph status: fresh at current HEAD.
- Changed components: prompt router artifact schema, new merger utility, deterministic merge test, scripts registry.
- Affected components: feature-run artifact lifecycle and review evidence consumption.
- Affected layers: Core + Test Layer.
- Risk: medium, because artifact wiring errors can silently produce misleading consensus summaries.

## Architectural gates

| Gate | Verdict | Decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 — Domain alignment | PASS | Comparative ledger normalization belongs to harness run artifacts. |
| 2 — Generality | PASS | A standalone merger utility keeps extraction logic reusable across review surfaces. |
| 3 — Ownership | PASS | `plan-review` and `council-review` remain source emitters; merger owns cross-source consolidation only. |
| 4 — Boundary integrity | PASS | Utility reads declared run artifacts and writes one final run-local ledger; no stage contract mutation. |
| 4b — Isolation/safety | PASS | Input paths remain repository-contained and run-id rooted; no external path or network input. |
| 5 — Reuse | PASS | Reuses existing comparative schema fields and existing review outputs instead of introducing a parallel schema. |

## Decisions

1. Extend feature-run manifest artifact slots to include `councilReviewEnvelope`, `planReviewJournal`, and `comparativeReviewFinalLedger`.
2. Add `merge-comparative-ledger.mjs` that merges:
   - prompt-pack comparative ledger template,
   - council-review envelope verdict evidence,
   - plan-review comparative block.
3. Detect reviewer disagreement by parsing member verdict lines in council responses and append explicit divergence entries.
4. Set final ledger status to `divergence` when disagreements exist, otherwise `consensus` when convergence evidence is present.
5. Add a deterministic test asserting disagreement produces non-empty divergence entries.

## Constraints and Do-NOTs

- Do not change existing `council-review` or `plan-review` output contracts in this slice.
- Do not infer consensus when disagreement entries exist.
- Do not write merged artifacts outside the repository or outside run-owned paths by default.
- Do not bypass run-id manifest tracking for final ledger output.

## Validation plan

- `npm run test:harness:comparative-ledger:merge`
- `npm run test:harness:prompt-router:run-bundle`
- `node scripts/harness/plan-review.mjs --self-test --json`
- `npm run harness:docs:check`

## Assumptions

| Assumption | Affects | Risk if wrong |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Council member outputs may include `VERDICT:` lines in disagreement scenarios. | Divergence extraction | Merger may under-report divergence and require richer envelope metadata. |
| Plan-review journals include `comparativeReviewLedger` when generated by current script version. | Plan-review ingestion | Merge remains partial and should mark missing evidence explicitly. |
| Feature-run manifest exists for target run-id. | Utility invocation | Merger cannot resolve artifact ownership and should fail fast. |
